records.Name: Morris may transfer to another store
records.Description__c: Morris Grey, our Regional Manager champion and primary decision maker, is rumored to be up for a transfer to another Joja store. Losing him mid-cycle would reset the relationship.
records.Mitigation_Plan__c: Broaden the coaching to Maru Bautista (IT Ops) and Lewis Thornton (CFO) so the deal is not single-threaded on Morris. Confirm his tenure through close before Negotiation.

records.Name: Joja corporate legal review delay
records.Description__c: Joja corporate legal is backlogged on the MSA redlines; the data-processing addendum is the long pole. Redlines returned but not yet countersigned.
records.Mitigation_Plan__c: Escalate to Joja legal via Lewis Thornton; offer our standard fallback DPA language to shorten the review. Track against the MSA-redlines follow-up task.

records.Name: FY27 renewal budget approval slipping
records.Description__c: Joja's FY27 membership budget is not locked; approval may slip past the 2026-10-15 close as finance reprioritizes spend. Renewal is at risk of pushing a quarter.
records.Mitigation_Plan__c: Get a written multi-year intent from Lewis Thornton before quarter-end; propose a co-terminus renewal aligned to the expansion so both close together.
